verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs say it can "generate and run simple Python code" for data analysis, plots and reports, so it has a real but narrow execution surface. Nothing in the evidence shows it running shell commands or editing files on the user's own machine; its file features are about syncing and indexing documents for search and chat. missing for 10: shell/command execution on the local machine, local file editing/writing, evidence of where code runs (local vs. remote), permission/approval controls, hands-on corroboration.
